[To [Mary Ann Moberly](/person/1019)]How little I thought when I met dear [Joanna Patteson](/person/1154) in your drawing-room that it was the last time I should see her! [Fanny Patteson](/person/1151) had come back, and is sure Joan knew and was thinking for others to the last. . . . I hope you are profiting by the splendid summer weather. I never knew a year of sweeter smells: the sheets of wild honeysuckle are quite amazing . . .
